scope: All canonical original-game card, relic and potion identities from pinned community tables, plus explicitly named first-upgrade references. Original factual effect summaries; incomplete values and conflicts preserved.

sources.title: include/constants/Cards.h
limitations: Community simulator table, not official game. Default energy cost is incomplete and was not imported. No full card effects assurance.

sources.title: include/constants/Relics.h
limitations: Names/IDs/tier catalog; includes special/endless relics.

sources.title: include/constants/Potions.h
limitations: Names/IDs/rarity/class pools. Invalid/empty sentinels excluded.

sources.title: src/combat/BattleContext.cpp
limitations: Community implementation with known bugs/TODOs. Blood Potion combat percentage ternary conflicts with same-project outside-combat path.

sources.title: src/game/GameContext.cpp
limitations: Community implementation; selected cited facts only.

sources.title: src/combat/Player.cpp
limitations: Community implementation; selected cited facts only.

sources.title: data/sts1/cards.json
limitations: No repository license found. Facts-only extraction; source patch unspecified.360 rows include2unused and omit12generated/choice cards. Null upgrade fields are not proof of no change.

sources.title: data/sts1/relics.json
limitations: Facts-only metadata; no prose/art imported. Includes Discerning Monocle excluded from active manifest.

sources.title: data/sts1/potions.json
limitations: Facts-only metadata;42actualpotionsincludingEntropicBrew. Separate numeric-values table omitsBrew/includesPotionSlot.

sources.title: data/sts1/relic_values.json
limitations: Raw value arrays are untyped, incomplete, and not effect semantics.

sources.title: STSDB0.3.0 upgrade metadata
sources.license: MIT advertised in package metadata; no license file in wheel; upstream-data permission unverified
limitations: Base CSV contains obsolete/pre2.2 values and removed entities; not used as broad base-stat authority. Generated/choice-card base facts are separately reviewed in card-mechanics.json. Upgrade literal numeric observations retained separately, not promoted to current canonical truth.
Includes unimplemented action bodies; signatures and dispatch do not prove working mechanics.
